skill.name: voc-research
skill.description: Extract verbatim Voice of Customer quotes from forums, reviews, social media, and support tickets for copywriting and messaging research.
skill.summary: Collect exact customer language, categorize quotes, and flag repeated patterns for messaging work.

security_audit.summary: The four static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline backticks and a fenced JSON example, not executable shell commands. No prompt injection text was found in SKILL.md. A separate privacy risk exists because the skill includes internal support tickets and exact quote preservation without redaction requirements.

content.value_statement: Teams often write copy without real customer language. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to collect exact quotes and organize them for messaging.
actual_capabilities: Searches listed sources such as Reddit, reviews, forums, and support tickets for customer language.
Captures verbatim quotes without paraphrasing or AI-generated wording.
Categorizes quotes into pain points, symptoms, dream outcomes, failed solutions, and buying decisions.
Marks repeated quote patterns as gold when they appear across at least three sources.
Records source context, category, sentiment, keywords, and gold status in a structured format.
limitations: It depends on access to source material and cannot verify private sources without permission.
It does not provide legal approval for using customer quotes in public marketing.
It needs human review to remove personal data from support tickets and reviews.
It is optimized for qualitative research, not statistically representative market sizing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Landing Page Messaging
use_cases.description: Collect exact complaints and desired outcomes before drafting section headlines and proof points.

use_cases.title: Review Product Positioning
use_cases.description: Compare repeated objections and switching reasons across forums, reviews, and support conversations.

use_cases.title: Build Client Research Briefs
use_cases.description: Create a quote bank that informs campaign angles, interviews, and messaging recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Find Pain Point Quotes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the VOC research skill for [product or category]. Search public reviews and forums. Return exact quotes, sources, categories, and repeated phrases.

prompt_templates.title: Group Messaging Themes
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these collected quotes. Group them into pain points, symptoms, dream outcomes, failed solutions, and buying decisions. Highlight phrases that repeat.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Customer Segments
prompt_templates.prompt: Research VOC for [segment A] and [segment B]. Keep exact quotes separate, compare recurring objections, and identify gold phrases for each segment.

prompt_templates.title: Build Campaign Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use public sources and approved internal tickets for [market]. Extract verbatim quotes, redact personal data, score frequency, and recommend messaging hypotheses.

output_examples.input: Research bookkeeping software complaints from small business owners.
output_examples.output: A quote bank grouped by pain points, failed solutions, and buying decisions, with sources and repeated phrases marked as gold.

output_examples.input: Analyze collected support ticket excerpts for onboarding friction.
output_examples.output: A theme summary showing exact customer wording, source context, frequency notes, and redaction reminders for sensitive details.

output_examples.input: Prepare VOC input before rewriting a SaaS landing page.
output_examples.output: Messaging insights that connect repeated customer phrases to headline angles, objections, and proof points.

best_practices: Use approved sources and keep source links or identifiers with every quote.
Redact personal data before storing or sharing internal support quotes.
Review gold quotes manually before turning them into public marketing copy.
anti_patterns: Do not invent quotes or clean up customer wording for polish.
Do not mix public reviews with private support data without labeling sources.
Do not treat repeated phrases as proof without checking source quality and relevance.

faq.question: What does this skill help me research?
faq.answer: It helps collect exact customer quotes from reviews, forums, social media, and approved internal sources.

faq.question: Does it paraphrase quotes?
faq.answer: No. The skill emphasizes verbatim quotes and keeps original wording, typos, and slang.

faq.question: Can it use private support tickets?
faq.answer: Yes, if you have authorized access. Redact personal data before storing or sharing any customer quote.

faq.question: What are gold quotes?
faq.answer: Gold quotes are phrases or complaints that appear across at least three sources.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is this a market sizing tool?
faq.answer: No. It supports qualitative messaging research and should not replace quantitative market analysis.
